description:
Road corridors where pedestrians were actually killed, from federal crash records.

Source: NHTSA FARS 2022-2024 (PER_TYP=5, INJ_SEV in 4,6). Each corridor carries the road name, the city, the total pedestrian deaths and a per-year breakdown, so a claim can be checked rather than taken on trust.

Give either a city, or a lat/lon with an optional radius. Use this when someone asks which roads are dangerous, where crashes happen, or wants evidence for a specific street. These are recorded deaths, not a model or a prediction: a road absent from the list had no recorded pedestrian fatality in the period, which is not the same as being safe.

city.description: City name or slug. Give this or lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude, to search around a point.

lon.description: Longitude, to search around a point.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km around lat/lon, default 10.

name: get_dangerous_corridors
